title: Give every variable a value
description:
This program adds up three scores, but `total` is never given a starting value. Reading a variable that was never set is **undefined behaviour**: on one machine it might print the right answer, on another some huge number, and in this app's debug build it stops the program.

Fix it so it reliably prints `60`.
hints: `int total;` reserves a box but puts nothing in it. Give it a starting value in braces.
lessonTitle: Compiler Settings, Build Configurations and Undefined Behavior
